featured_reviews.name: Priya Dabhade
featured_reviews.review_text:
My father-in-law was admitted to Olive Care Center for three months, and our experience has been extremely positive. The care provided was excellent, especially the wound care—his wound improved from grade 3 to completely healed skin. The rehabilitation program was also very well planned and executed, contributing significantly to his recovery.
We would like to sincerely appreciate Dr. Himanshu and the entire medical team for their dedication, expertise, and compassionate approach. A special mention and heartfelt thanks to Mukesh and Vinod who provided one-to-one care for Papa. They were incredibly kind, empathetic, and patient, and walked alongside Papa throughout his recovery journey, offering constant support and encouragement.
We would also like to highlight the team’s ( Mr Hemant operational director) responsiveness to feedback—they promptly installed parallel bars following our suggestion, which further enhanced the rehabilitation experience.
Overall, we are truly grateful to Olive Care Center for the quality care and support provided, and we highly recommend the facility to others.

featured_reviews.name: Gunjan Mirchandani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our family is deeply grateful to the entire team at Olive Senior Care, Malad, for the outstanding palliative care provided to my mother in her final days.
The staff not only ensured her medical and physical comfort but also extended immense emotional and spiritual support — to her and to our family. Their kindness, patience, and empathy brought her peace and dignity in her most vulnerable moments.
Thank you for helping us navigate this difficult journey with such compassion and grace.

featured_reviews.name: Sanjay Rachelkar
featured_reviews.review_text: I was sent to the centre by my family and it was against my will. In the initial days of my stay, I used to be very restless and angry. Over the course of my stay at the centre, I understood that the level of alcohol I was consuming was very harmful for me. My health, relationship and overall environment was getting affected due to alcohol. Counselling by Khushi ma'am helped me a lot understanding the adverse affects of alcohol and understanding the life after alcohol. Dr. Himanshu, Dr. Saddam and Dr. Mahesh were also very co-operative and helpful in my journey. The centre also has a proper systematic routine including yoga , psycho education session, group physical activity and the games that we used to play everyday were very fun. I am very thankful for the centre for my progress and my family is also very grateful

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Hendwale
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was earlier sceptical also I gave lot of trouble to Ganesh and team initially but they have patiently listened and implemented things which I suggested them. The target was to achieve 1500 steps per day initially for my father but now he is walking 2500 steps per day. A great improvement and I can suggest everyone to visit this place for your elderly.

Best place for elderly people around this side of mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Dileep Kumar Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Olive Elder Care in Mumbai for my uncle, and honestly it was a relief to see such a warm and clean place for senior citizens. The staff was realy caring and always available for help. My uncle was little nervous in the begining but now he looks much happy and relaxed.

featured_reviews.name: arti dhage
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our aunt was admitted to Vishram senior citizen caring center during the last stage of her life, and I cannot express how thankful we are to the entire staff. From day one, they treated her with dignity, patience, and genuine warmth. The nurses monitored her health closely, the caregivers helped with daily needs, and the doctors were always available to explain things to us.

What stood out most was the emotional support. They didn’t just care for her physically; they sat with her, talked to her, and made sure she never felt alone. When she passed away, the staff handled everything with such sensitivity. They guided us through the procedures after death, helped with paperwork, and gave us space to grieve.

In a difficult time, they became like family. If you’re looking for a place that treats residents with respect and supports families too, I highly recommend Vishram senior citizen caring center.
